name: oceanhud
description: Ocean Hub v18 — Ocean Liquid Glass UI, and fail-closed payments, HMAC key indexing, and no external object-storage dependency

scripts.deploy:production: node preflight_deploy_v18.mjs production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production_v18.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run security:check && npm run test:email-flow && npm run test:keys-at-rest && npm run test:key-index-routes && npm run test:backup-migration-tools && npm run test:ui-theme && npm run test:paypal-mode && npm run test:stable-horde
scripts.deploy:staging: node preflight_deploy_v18.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.check:syntax: node --check OceanHub_SECURITY_PATCHED_FINAL_v18.js && node --check preflight_deploy_v18.mjs && node --check security_checks_v18.mjs && node --check email_verification_flow_test.mjs && node --check key_at_rest_test_v18.mjs && node --check key_index_route_test_v18.mjs && node --check backup_migration_tool_test_v18.mjs && node --check ui_theme_test_v18.mjs && node --check paypal_mode_test_v18.mjs && node --check stable_horde_test_v18.mjs
